A private, paid, ad-free and personally customizable search engine: Uruky [1]. It was launched earlier this year and reached 400 MAUs and €2k MRR last month.

A simple EU static and app hosting service: PodBy [2]. It was launched last week, and is at €10 MRR.

Thank you for asking and for your suggestions!

[1]: https://uruky.com

[2]: https://podby.com
